pm_rationale: Short DOW on cyclical commodity chemical margin compression, high leverage vulnerability in rising rates, and continued industrial demand weakness hitting lowest-value-add chemicals hardest.
portfolio_thesis: Consensus expects commodity chemical margins to stabilize in H2 2026 as raw material costs ease and China demand recovers. We believe commodity chemicals face structural margin pressure as oversupply from Middle East capacity additions coincides with permanent demand destruction from packaging sustainability trends. DOW's polyethylene exposure is particularly vulnerable to secular plastic reduction initiatives.
